CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation relation bound to identified content/time.

COD.rationale: Content (identified color at a node), its organizational placement (node path) and an explicit origin/status field are all present for the same referent/time.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or content-processing condition is linked to the identified content's organization/access.

C.rationale: Multiple entries explicitly identify content attributes (colour) bound to specific node referents.

D.rationale: Origins/status fields are separately attributed to identified contents, distinguishing identification from status/origin.

O.rationale: Contents are presented within a structured node/candidate hierarchy (current vs candidate nodes) describing their organization/access.
